scope: An engine-backed defence of the same advanced passed pawn by changing the king flights after the same check.
nomination: Use the engine's leading quiet root and the scored played choice. A legal sixth-to-seventh noncapturing passer advance must occur immediately after the played move in the paired line, or in a separate searched reply which still gives the opponent an advantage over the better root. Play that same advance after both choices. Look for the same direct check by a different piece whose king flights are restricted by the piece relocated by the better root. Use at most one pawn advance per game.
economy: Search from the better reached board after the push without restriction (MultiPV two). Check the played reached board with the same checking move restricted only if the check is a close leading defence. Compare a 500k-node budget with a 2.4M-node reference, using the same two reached boards and policy. Minimum completed depth is 16.
evidence: The same check must be within 50 cp of the leading defence. The better branch must stay at least as close as 90 cp below the stronger root evaluation. The played counterpart must be at least 120 cp worse from the defender's perspective. Its leading line must use a specific king flight covered by the moved piece. The strict arm requires the weaker line to take the same checker with its king in the first six plies. The broader arm also accepts the original pawn promoting and keeping its new piece for four plies. The stronger line must show capture of the original pawn in the first 12 plies. The broader arm was specified after inspecting the development case and before seeing the game-disjoint transfer. Neither result establishes an overall position label.
evaluation: Review every engine nomination. Measure engine cost, geometry-only false leads and budget agreement. Exclude Lugano from validation counts. Use cached games and a fresh game-disjoint classical reserve. Recheck every confirmed reference at 4.8M nodes per search. The short search is a candidate for integration only if its new diagnoses persist and the extra queries are worthwhile.
